items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: So we wound up in the picture, but that's when I first met Jacobi.

ctx.x: Yeah. That was one of the first supper club in New York on the east side.
Herbert Jacobi, who had come over here from France during the war --
Jacobi had a room in Paris called "Le boeuf sur le toît," in which a lot of the American musicians and acts played there during the better days.
